missions.title: Silk for the Wings
missions.briefing: My pilots fly in patched canopies. Petal Silk holds where nothing else will.

missions.title: Fuel the Pathfinder
missions.briefing: Powder runs on grain and amber. Fill the holds and we fly further.

complete.text: Meet the harvest quota on 6 waves

missions.title: Crystal Discipline
missions.briefing: Sustainable margins, Commander. Bring the quartz home without bleeding the ledger.

complete.text: Claim the uncommon resource on 5 waves

missions.title: Not One Brick
missions.briefing: Three fights, my walls stay standing — that’s the whole job.

missions.title: Clean Hands
missions.briefing: Defend the realm without staining it. Not one shell on the keep.

missions.title: Escort Duty
missions.briefing: I carry every tribe’s dead. I would rather not carry your harvesters.

missions.title: Silence the Blight
missions.briefing: Thin Sear’s swarm. Spare the mulch; it never chose.

missions.title: Clear the Flight Lanes
missions.briefing: Raiders are picking off our supply flyers. Ground them.

missions.title: Debt of the Reef
missions.briefing: Vex Marrow shelled my reef. Avenge it, then help me rebuild.

missions.title: Tower Discipline
missions.briefing: Precision spares more than it kills. Let the rockets do the talking.

missions.title: Thaw the Line
missions.briefing: Every doctrine fears the freeze. I merely record who survives it.

missions.title: Field Promotion
missions.briefing: A sergeant who holds the line earns the right to lead it.

missions.title: R&D Partnership
missions.briefing: Ship what heals before what harms. Show me you invest.

missions.title: Wings Need Wrenches
missions.briefing: I fix wings. You fix the harvester budget.

missions.title: Friends Among the Stars
missions.briefing: Explore, uplift, protect. Earn the Fleet’s trust and the frontier opens.

unlock.text: Fulfil the Space Tech contract on map 2

missions.title: Order Through Fire
missions.briefing: The border villages hoard their Heartwood. Take it. Order is a ledger.

missions.title: The Deep Keeps Balance
missions.briefing: Take only what the tide gives back. The deep remembers greed.

missions.title: Erase the Self
missions.briefing: Only the Movement remains. Prove you have nothing left to lose.

view.text: Alignment Pure Evil or below (hidden until then)

missions.title: Halo’s Clock
missions.briefing: Fly clean, land fast. Beat my time.

missions.title: A Quiet Exchange
missions.briefing: Some of what you dig is not yours to keep. I will pay well for it.

unlock.text: Accept the Contact’s call in orbit

missions.title: Chart the Far Side
missions.briefing: Sensors ping Helium-3 on the dark side. I plot courses; you decide if it is real.
